entities.description: Customer-period consumption; glossary defines the period as YYYYMM. Consumption units are not established.

grain.meaning: one row per customer and YYYYMM period

entities.description: Transaction payment Price and purchased quantity Amount. Never combine account currencies without an explicit conversion definition.

metrics.label: Total consumption
metrics.description: Copied from business glossary monthly consumption. Sum recorded consumption at the requested grouping grain; no physical or monetary unit inferred.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Preserve NULL for no observations; do not fill missing months or remove negative adjustments.

metrics.label: Total spending
metrics.description: Copied from glossary total spending. Price is transaction payment, not quantity. Restrict or group by verified customer currency; never sum mixed currencies as one monetary total.
metrics.rollup: Only within a single verified currency; no exchange-rate conversion is defined.

metrics.label: Average unit price
metrics.description: Copied exactly from glossary: unweighted mean of transaction-level unit prices. Not a weighted price and not an average of subgroup averages. Requires compatible product units and a single currency.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Zero quantities produce NULL unit prices excluded by AVG; no zero imputation.

metrics.label: Weighted average unit price
metrics.description: Glossary quantity-weighted unit price, only when explicitly requested. Requires compatible product units and one currency. Cast enforces real division without changing the intended ratio.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Return NULL when total quantity is zero; do not replace ordinary average unit price.
